picks.thesis: Genuine convergence. Six congressional buys span Cisneros, Allen (x2), Letlow and Fields (x2), all in the $1k-15k band from Jan-May (some stale, lag to 39d). The standout is the insider tape: eleven TSM officers — including Chairman & CEO Wei Che-Chia and both Co-COOs — bought open-market, non-10b5-1, on 2026-06-05 (lag 4d), with VP Yuan adding on 6/22. Fresh, broad and senior insider accumulation corroborating a multi-member congressional pattern. Price 421.21, down 9.9% over 30d, mid-range of the 90d 381.77-477.57 band — insiders buying into weakness.
key_risks: Insider buys are modest in size and clustered on a single day (6/05), so may reflect a routine compensation-linked purchase window rather than opportunistic conviction
Several congressional buys are months old (lag up to 39d) and disclosure lags reality
ADR of a foreign issuer exposed to policy/geopolitical scrutiny
picks.invalidation: TSM insiders or the congressional buyers begin filing sales, or the price breaks below the 90-day low of 381.77 while insider buying stops.

picks.thesis: Convergence with a single congressional filer. Rep. David Taylor bought IBP four times (Jan-Jun, each $1k-15k, latest 6/15, lag 16d). That the operating officers are buying is the meaningful part. Tempered by resting on one member of Congress. key_risks: Only one congressional filer (Taylor), whose committees (Agriculture, Transportation) have weak sector nexus to IBP
Insider buys, while genuine, are one-off and the stock remains far below its 90d high
Small/mid-cap housing-linked name with range-y price action
picks.invalidation: IBP insiders reverse to selling, or the price falls back toward the 90-day low of 195.28 with no further buying.

picks.thesis: A four-member congressional cluster — Cisneros, Fetterman, Whitehouse and Armstrong — with Fetterman and Whitehouse flagged as committee-aligned to semis/tech. key_risks: Most of the cluster is stale (March buys), and one filing was 116 days late
No insider buying to confirm the congressional signal
Deep 30-day drawdown signals momentum working against the thesis
picks.invalidation: Fresh member sales appear, or MU keeps falling toward the 90-day low of 481.65 without new congressional or insider buying.

picks.thesis: Eleven Quantinuum insiders — directors and the CFO — bought open-market, non-10b5-1, all on 2026-06-05, ranging from Narang's $12k to Barron's $15.0M (Bhatia $1.2M, Jimenez $4.0M, others $240k-$900k). One congressional buyer, Fields, bought $1k-15k on 6/4. The scale is eye-catching, but the single-day concentration reads more like a coordinated or founder/placement-type block than opportunistic accumulation, and it leans on one congressional filer. Price 54.88, down 19.6% over 30d, just above the 90d low of 51.40 (high 83.17).
key_risks: All insider buys land on one date, suggesting a mechanical/placement block rather than free-market conviction
Only one congressional filer, in a small band
Newly public, illiquid-type name trading near its 90d low with a steep 30d decline
picks.invalidation: Insiders begin selling the 6/05 block, or the price breaks the 90-day low of 51.40 with no new buying.
